reviewNotes.functionalScope: The eight named runtime steps passed. Initial fixtures are explicitly controlled. Only crystal-fibre low was randomly selected in both independent contexts.
reviewNotes.captureTiming: Waited 350ms before every screenshot for the existing UI entrance animation.
reviewNotes.pauseGuardEvidence: Saved blocked snapshot DOM contains only 尚未保存 · 点击重试 and scene remains active. Original DOM assertion used a nonexistent #pause-menu; script now uses the actual .pause-menu-panel selector. The recorded DOM independently excludes an opened menu.
visualObservations: Healer remains visibly present to the left; one action and numerical before/after are readable after entrance animation.
Impact report retains the base scene and shows actual HP and damage.
P100/A60 reveals more terrain than P100/A0 while retaining the same red pollution erosion; edge HUD does not overlap in these captures.
openUiContractGaps: Eligible preview omits purifier actual HP and the 25-HP threshold; these are only shown when eligibility fails. Current tide/intensity is also absent from that preview, contrary to spec P1.
A15 actual impact increase is 7.5%, but preview shows +7% due to integer formatting and floating-point rounding.
limitations: No natural travel to cultivation chamber or rift device; their production scene entry methods were called.
No natural expedition economy, full ruined-base recovery, long-term balance, sound quality or human aesthetic acceptance.
Only Chrome on this local desktop; no Firefox/Safari or performance acceptance.
